en: Black‑and‑white view of a late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century villa‑style building with striped masonry and steep roofs, signed as a restaurant. It sits along a wide dirt road with a low hedge and simple wooden fences in front. A few small trees line the road and two children stand near the fence. In the background a prominent, steep, flat‑topped mountain rises behind the building, with more hills stretching off to the side. The overall look is of a rural or resort restaurant set in a mountainous landscape.
